camel_example: aliyun ecs ModifyInstanceMaintenanceAttributes --region cn-hangzhou --MaintenanceWindow.1.EndTime '18:00:00' --MaintenanceWindow.1.StartTime '02:00:00' --ActionOnMaintenance AutoRecover --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --InstanceId.1 'i-bp67acfmxazb4ph0000' --NotifyOnMaintenance false
description_en: Modifies the maintenance attributes of an instance
kebab_example: aliyun ecs modify-instance-maintenance-attributes --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --action-on-maintenance AutoRecover --notify-on-maintenance false --instance-id i-bp67acfmxazb4ph0000 --maintenance-window EndTime=18:00:00 StartTime=02:00:00 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyInstanceMaintenanceAttributes

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 实例所属的地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The maintenance action. Valid values:

Stop: The instance is stopped (that is, the instance goes down).
AutoRecover: The instance is automatically recovered.
AutoRedeploy: The instance is redeployed upon downtime, with possible data disk loss
parameters.help_zh:
维护动作。取值范围：

Stop：停止状态（即宕机）。
AutoRecover：自动恢复。
AutoRedeploy：宕机迁移，数据盘有损
parameters.name: action_on_maintenance

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to send an event notification before instance downtime maintenance. Valid values:

true: An event notification is sent.
false: No event notification is sent.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
实例宕机运维前是否发送事件通知。取值范围：

true：发送事件通知。
false：不发送事件通知。

默认值：false
parameters.name: notify_on_maintenance

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. Valid values of N: 1 to 100
parameters.name: instance_id

fields.help_en: The end time of the time window. The time must be on the hour. Minutes and seconds cannot be specified. The start time and end time must be specified together, and the interval between them must be 1 to 23 hours. The time is in the UTC+8 time zone and in the `HH:mm:ss` format. Valid values of N: 1. Only one time window can be specified
fields.help_zh: 维护时间窗口结束时间。必须为整小时，不允许设置分、秒。开始时间和结束时间必须同时设置，并且结束时间与开始时间需要间隔1~23个整小时。采用UTC +8时区，格式为`HH:mm:ss`。N的取值为1，只支持设置1个时间窗口
fields.name: end_time

fields.help_en: The start time of the time window. The time must be on the hour. Minutes and seconds cannot be specified. The start time and end time must be specified together, and the interval between them must be 1 to 23 hours. The time is in the UTC+8 time zone and in the `HH:mm:ss` format. Valid values of N: 1. Only one time window can be specified
fields.help_zh: 维护时间窗口开始时间。必须为整小时，不允许设置分、秒。开始时间和结束时间必须同时设置，并且结束时间与开始时间需要间隔1~23个整小时。采用UTC +8时区，格式为`HH:mm:ss`。N的取值为1，只支持设置1个时间窗口
fields.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The list of maintenance time windows
parameters.name: maintenance_window
